props.name: text
props.description: Text to reveal. Pass multiple strings to rotate when {@link DiaTextRevealProps.repeat} is `true`.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors sampled across the moving gradient band. Defaults to a built-in palette.

props.name: textColor
props.description: CSS color for revealed text after the sweep and for leading/trailing regions during the animation.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of one sweep pass, in seconds.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before the sweep starts, in seconds.

props.name: repeat
props.description: When `text` is an array, replay the sweep and advance to the next string after each completion.

props.name: repeatDelay
props.description: Pause between cycles when {@link DiaTextRevealProps.repeat} is `true`, in seconds.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: If `true`, the animation starts only after the element enters the viewport.

props.name: once
props.description: Passed to `useInView`: if `true`, in-view detection fires at most once (no replay on scroll-back).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class names for the animated `span` (e.g. typography utilities).

props.name: fixedWidth
props.description: When `text` has multiple entries, use the widest string’s width for layout instead of animating width per line.
